order.description: Physical reading order of the two name parts in this document: given_family means first name before surname; family_given means surname before first name. Use unknown if not defensible.
order.title: Order

evidence.description: Brief document evidence for the order: literal headings, their positions or a combined-name separator. Do not use an external roster, a name dictionary or guess from individual names.
evidence.title: Evidence

VisualParticipant.description: Compact VLM output; empty strings and unknown nulls remain distinguishable.

person_role.description: instructor only for a person explicitly labelled Kursleiter, Trainer, Dozent or equivalent. Never infer the role from a name, department, signature or row position.
person_role.title: Person Role

role_evidence.description: Copy the literal role label belonging to this person, e.g. Kursleiter or Trainer. Use null when no explicit role label exists; never copy a label belonging to another person.
role_evidence.title: Role Evidence

personnel_number.description: Value only from this person's Benutzer / User ID / Personalnummer cell. Use '' if visibly blank, null if masked, unreadable or ambiguous. Never substitute Kurzzeichen, department or a course/Class ID. Keep the person even without this ID.
personnel_number.title: Personnel Number

department.description: Value only from Kurzzeichen / Abteilung / Organisation in this person's row, even when Benutzer is blank. May contain letters, digits, hyphens or slashes. Use '' if visibly blank, null if unknown.
department.title: Department

VisualParticipant.title: VisualParticipant

page_text.description: Fallback only: transcribe all legible text if participants is empty; otherwise null.
page_text.title: Page Text
